title: Eleven Votes and One Lamp
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：council　|　正文 330 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 council 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 my grandmother ① petitioned a council about a lamp that had not lit in eleven years, and she said the petitioning was the whole of the winter. The ② council, meaning the body and not the building, met on a Tuesday and stayed that way; council, she said, is the only thing in a village that is judged by how slowly it answers.

Every ③ council in that district had the same agenda, and the ④ council at the end, meaning the one she kept for the lamp and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever attended twice. Council, my mother said, is nine parts agenda and one part somebody willing to attend; my grandmother said the attending is the part that fills the winter.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the council was the whole of the meeting, meaning the assembly and not the body. The ⑥ council, meaning the assembly and not any of that, is the only thing in a meeting that everybody addresses and nobody elects; council, he said, is either something you petition or the only word that means both a body and an assembly. She said the assembly is the part they remember.

By 1962 the ⑦ council had become a line in a minute book, and the book had become an argument about the agenda. The ⑧ council of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in January, was one lamp and thirty years of attending; council, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to attend. He said the attending was never mentioned.

The ⑨ council I remember is the one at the end, which met in 1968 and is still described as the slowest in the county. A ⑩ council, my mother said in 1970, is the only thing that improves by being attended; every council, she said, is an assembly that has agreed to look like a body. She said the assembly was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 委员会；理事会
B. n. 委员会（指那个机构本身，与那座办公楼相对）
C. 固定搭配：petition a council 向委员会请愿
D. n. 委员会（指那个区里每一个）
E. n. 委员会（指末尾那一个）
F. n. 会议；议事会（指集会本身）
G. n. 委员会（指会议记录簿里提到的那一个）
H. n. 议事机构；地方议会（抽象总称）

items.q: petitioned a council about a lamp that had not lit
The council, meaning the body and not the building
the council was the whole of the meeting
the council had become a line in a minute book
The council of the whole thing
A council, my mother said in 1970

answers.why: petition a council 意为“向委员会请愿”，1954 年祖母就一盏十一年没亮过的路灯向委员会请愿。
council 意为“委员会”，指那个机构本身而不是那座办公楼，它在星期二开会。
council 指那个区里每一个委员会，每一个都用同一份议程。
council 指末尾那一个（她为路灯找的那一个），是唯一有人出席过两次的。
council 意为“会议、议事会”，父亲说议事会就是那场会的全部，指的是集会本身而不是那个机构。
council 为另一个义项，指集会本身而不是那个机构，是会议里人人都致辞、却无人选举的东西。
council 意为“委员会”，指会议记录簿里提到的那一个，到 1962 年这个委员会成了记录簿里的一行。
council 意为“议事机构、地方议会”，祖母一月写道，整件事的议事机构是一盏路灯三十年的出席。
council 意为“委员会”，我记得的是末尾那一个，1968 年开过会，至今仍被说成全县最慢的。
council 为抽象总称，母亲说一个委员会是唯一会因为被出席而变好的东西。
